verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents two first-party scheduling capabilities: future-dated Pix and TED transfers ([stark-bank-docs-17]), and recurring inbound Pix payments after a one-time authorization ([stark-bank-docs-13]). Both are banking-specific operations, not a general facility for scheduling recurring jobs or workflows, and the depth of each is not shown. Missing for 10: a general recurring job/workflow scheduler, recurrence rules for outbound operations, API docs detailing schedule configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
